summary.zh: 把睡觉放进日程，而不是等角色撑不住再补救。
summary.en: Schedule sleep before exhaustion chooses for you.

rules.zh: 行动和清醒时间累积疲劳，削弱后续效率。玩家选择何时休息、休息多久以及在哪里睡；睡醒后的精力、时间和环境变化共同决定下一段活动。
rules.en: Activity and time awake build fatigue and weaken later performance. Choose when, how long and where to sleep; restored energy, elapsed time and changed surroundings shape the next outing.

loop.en: Return or find a resting place

decisions.zh: 再做一件事能带回收益，但可能错过安全返程时间。
decisions.en: One more task may pay, but cost the safe return window.

decisions.zh: 短睡保住白天，长睡减少下一次中断。
decisions.en: A short sleep preserves daylight; a long sleep delays the next interruption.

effect.zh: 先影响搬运或战斗会迫使提前安排；只在归零惩罚容易拖到最后一刻。
effect.en: Early carrying or combat penalties encourage planning; zero-only penalties invite delay.

effect.zh: 前半段恢复快，鼓励小睡；越睡越有效则鼓励完整休整。
effect.en: Fast early recovery favors naps; increasing returns favor full rests.

implementation.zh: 清醒和活动消耗疲劳条，疲劳会降低可携带负重，睡眠恢复精力。
implementation.en: Wakefulness and activity drain the fatigue meter; tiredness reduces carrying capacity, while sleeping restores energy.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：室内休整点可用于规划返程，静态图不能显示恢复速度。
observation.en: System reference: an indoor resting place contextualizes return planning, not recovery speed.

implementation.zh: 单人模式中，疲劳增加睡眠需求并影响战斗；玩家寻找床等地点睡眠。多人是否需要睡眠由服务器设置决定。
implementation.en: In single-player, fatigue creates sleep pressure and affects combat. Players sleep in suitable places; multiplayer sleep requirements depend on server settings.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：积雪覆盖住宅区；这张图没有打开疲劳或营养面板。
observation.en: System reference: Snow covers a residential area; fatigue and nutrition panels are not open in this image. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: 漫漫长夜让疲劳直接改变搬运预算；僵尸毁灭工程还要考虑睡眠地点与周围威胁。
contrast.en: The Long Dark changes carrying capacity; Project Zomboid also makes the resting location and nearby threats important.

combination.zh: 设计提案：限时委托允许分段交货，玩家要在赶工和睡眠恢复之间安排两次出行。
combination.en: Design proposal: allow staged contract deliveries, making players schedule two trips around work and sleep.

setup.zh: 演示设定：天黑前剩三轮，送货需两轮，精力只够一轮。
setup.en: Example: three turns until dark, a two-turn delivery, one turn of energy.

action.en: Sleep for one turn to recover.

result.zh: 能完成送货，但已没有绕路余量。
result.en: Delivery is now possible, with no detour margin.

next.zh: 下次接单先比较距离与休息需求。
next.en: Compare distance and rest needs before the next contract.

firstStep.zh: 只做白天倒计时、精力条和三个地点，睡眠按轮恢复。
firstStep.en: Use a daylight clock, energy meter and three locations, with turn-based sleep.

pitfall.zh: 把睡觉做成长时间无法操作的等待会打断体验；允许加速。
pitfall.en: Long idle waits interrupt play; allow fast-forward.

test.zh: 观察玩家是否在精力耗尽前主动返程。
test.en: Observe whether players return before reaching exhaustion.
